## Welcome to NovaStream Media
NovaStream Media Private Limited, located at 88 Digital Hub, Hyderabad, Telangana, provides premium algorithmic content streaming and digital advertising services.

## Consent Interoperability Restrictions
To protect our proprietary advertising ecosystem, NovaStream Media Private Limited affirmatively prohibits users from delegating their consent preferences to any Board-registered Consent Manager, requiring all consent actions to be manually executed exclusively through our proprietary interface.

## Internal Privacy Tools
Users can seamlessly review, manage, and update their consent preferences at any time using our dedicated internal privacy dashboard. We deploy industry-standard encryption across all user portals to ensure your account settings remain secure.
